reviews.comment: If you can avoid this class, please do. You're better off reading a couple Wikipedia articles than taking this professor. The class is test heavy, exams are unnecessarily difficult being memorization heavy on pointless details. Dr. Graf is unapproachable - if you go to her outside of class for help, she is dismissive and condescending.

We had 6 grades so everything counts. The tests were too hard for what is supposed to be an introductory class. You have to memorize lots of information about exact dates and random information that was deemed important.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: She was very organized and was very passionate about the class. She would sometimes spend 30 minutes on one slide so lectures were not always extremely helpful. Tests are pretty hard so study hard. Do not rely on a curve.

I have never been so appalled by a professor. After failing both of the first exams alongside of the majority of my class, I emailed Graf to ask for studying guidance. The next class, she looked at me and said 'its no wonder we get the grades we do because stare at her while she lectures instead of writing at all times'. Don't. Take. Her. Classes.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough grader--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Kelly really isnt an appropriate name for this prof, I think "Karen" describes her much better. Very rude, and obnoxious, completely unprofessional. Do not take Kelly Graf if you have the option to. For projects she "checks in" on you to make sure you are citing sources correctly and doing your project ahead of time. Super nosy.
reviews.ratingTags: Lots of homework--Beware of pop quizzes--So many papers

reviews.comment: She was an ok prof- obviously really passionate about the subject but rambles sooo much in lecture. Also the tests are really difficult and specific, so study stuff like specific dates and people.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Test heavy--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: I had her for fall of 2021 for ANTH 204 which is supposed to be an intro class, but it was very difficult. In the class your grade is just 3 tests and 2 essays. For our first exam we had an average of a 70 with over 100 people in the class, and for the second exam the average was in the 60's. Do not recommend this professor she does not give EC.
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Graded by few things--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Lectures are read right from the powerpoints (which are posted after for use). Over half the information on exams is from the textbook. Lecture material not very prevalent in exams. Insanely difficult tests given- even if you studied intensely the questions are sometimes too complicated to the point where it is impossible to all get right.

Prof. Graf gets a bad rap, but I highly recommend her. Lectures can get a bit dull, but if you can pay attention and stay interested they are actually really cool. Tests are straight from the lectures, with a bit from the textbook. Textbook reading assignments are insanely easy. Dropped the lowest exam as a surprise. Overall, chill prof.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Dr. Graf has been an excellent Professor this semester. I took this class online and she posted all her lecture slides with commentary under it of the important information that was on exams. Not sure if it was because of COVID, but, she had the exams open note and open for 24 hours. The homework are tricky, but doable. I would take this class!
reviews.ratingTags: Graded by few things--Clear grading criteria--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: As a prof, she was great! She was very passionate about the subject, and very nice and easy to talk to. The only thing for me was that the tests were so detailed and the reviews were so broad, it was really hard to get an A. Gives little quizes every day in class that are participation grades. Never used the book, but lectures are very important.
reviews.ratingTags: Clear grading criteria--GRADED BY FEW THINGS--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Tests are really difficult because they include such tiny details. She's not available after class even though she does have office time for students. If you visit her in her office it's clear she thinks you're bothering her and wasting her time. Tries to be funny in class sometimes,  but isn't that funny.

Information in lectures presented in an unclear manner. Seems annoyed with questions. Attendance isn't taken, but  there are I-Clicker quizzes every class over both reading and lectures. Makes the class harder than it needs to be. She is very passionate and humorous but occasionally comes off as rude. Fill in the blank portion on tests.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: I fell asleep in this class every time I went. She made it way harder than it had to be with putting the tiniest little details on the tests. The 2 papers SUCKED. Lean on the TA's help because she's rude and not helpful. The extra credit was extensive but do it because there are so few grades in the course.
Doesn't clearly answer questions and seems annoyed if you ask. Extremely tiny details on tests. Not approachable if you have any problems. Do NOT take this class

If you have no knowledge of anthropology then I would not take this class. The only reason I passed this class was because of my TA who was amazing. I learned way more from her. You will have I-Cliker quizzes everyday and those are 25 points of your total grade. You MUST read and  the test have very small details in them.
Sweet lady, but she makes the subject boring. It's definitely not impossible to make an A, but her tests do include tiny little details.
theory based class, not at all what I was expecting. she's funny though, tests are easy if you study the book and review sheets!
